```{r packages,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE,include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(lfe)
library(stargazer)
library(fixest)
library(tidyverse)
library(DescTools) 
```

```{r read_data,include=FALSE}
input_path='~/Dropbox/data_quickpay/qp_replication/input/'
reg_df=fread(paste0(input_path,
                 'quickpay_delays.csv'))
```

```{r regs, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Treated projects
a=reg_df[treat_i==1 &
           recipient_duns!=0,
       .(num_small=n_distinct(contract_award_unique_key)),
       by=c('recipient_duns',
            'action_date_year_quarter')]

# Control projects
b=reg_df[treat_i==0 &
           recipient_duns!=0,
         .(num_large=n_distinct(contract_award_unique_key)),
         by=c('recipient_duns',
              'action_date_year_quarter')]

c=merge(a,
        b,
        by=c('recipient_duns',
             'action_date_year_quarter'),
        all=T)

# If no small or no large project for a contractor, set as zero
c[is.na(c)]=0

c[,prop_small:=num_small/(num_small+num_large)]
c[,post_t:=ifelse(action_date_year_quarter>=as.Date('2011-04-27'),
                      1,0)]

# Contractors that have at least one small and at least one large project
m1=feols(prop_small~post_t|recipient_duns,
      data=c)

m2=feols(prop_small~post_t|recipient_duns,
      data=c[prop_small>0
                       &prop_small<1])

c[,Q:=relevel(as.factor(action_date_year_quarter),
                            ref="2011-03-31")]

m3=feols(prop_small~Q|recipient_duns,
      data=c)

m4=feols(prop_small~Q|recipient_duns,
      data=c[prop_small>0
                       &prop_small<1])

setFixest_dict(c(post_t="$Post_t$", 
                 recipient_duns="Contractor",
                 action_date_year_quarter="Time"))

etable(m1,m2,
       tex=T,
       extralines = list("Sub-sample"=c("All contractors", 
                                        "Contractors with \n both type of projects")))

etable(m3,m4,
       tex=T,
       extralines = list("Sub-sample"=c("All contractors", 
                                        "Contractors with \n both type of projects")))

```

```{r time_plot, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
c[,type:=case_when(prop_small==1~"Only small projects",
                   prop_small==0~"Only large projects",
                   prop_small>0 & prop_small<1 ~ "Both S&L projects")]

c_avg=c[,.(avg_small=mean(num_small,na.rm=T),
           avg_large=mean(num_large,na.rm=T)),
        by=c('action_date_year_quarter',
             'type')]

ggplot(c_avg, 
       aes(x=as.factor(action_date_year_quarter),
           y=avg_small,
           group=type,
           linetype=type,
           color=type,
           shape=type))+
    geom_point()+geom_line()+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, 
                                     vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))+
    xlab("Time")+
    ylab("Average number of small projects")+
    ggtitle("Full sample")

ggplot(c_avg, 
       aes(x=as.factor(action_date_year_quarter),
           y=avg_large,
           group=type,
           linetype=type,
           color=type,
           shape=type))+
    geom_point()+geom_line()+
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, 
                                     vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))+
    xlab("Time")+
    ylab("Average number of large projects")+
    ggtitle("Full sample")

c_avg_2=c[prop_small>0 &
            prop_small<1,
          .(avg_prop=mean(prop_small,na.rm=T)),
        by=c('action_date_year_quarter')]

ggplot(c_avg_2, 
       aes(x=as.factor(action_date_year_quarter),
           y=avg_prop,group=1))+
  geom_point()+geom_line()+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, 
                                   vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))+
  xlab("Time")+
  ylab("Average proportion of small projects")+
  ggtitle("Contractors holding both types of projects")
```
